sources.excerpt: Xotic AC Booster V2 — Grokipedia Search ⌘K Suggest Edit Sign in Sign in Overview Description Development Design and controls Main controls DIP switches Boost stage Technical specifications Physical and electrical specs Power requirements Sound characteristics Gain and overdrive range Tone shaping and EQ Dynamic response and transparency Comparisons To original AC Booster To Xotic Soul Driven References Fact-checked by Grok 6 months ago Xotic AC Booster V2 Ara Eve Leo Sal 1x The Xotic AC Booster V2 is an updated overdrive/boost pedal from Xotic Effects, released in 2025 as an enhanced successor to the original AC Booster. It delivers transparent, dynamic overdrive ranging from clean boost to medium gain levels with amp-like touch sensitivity, while adding a footswitchable secondary boost stage with its own gain control and a side-mounted 4-pole DIP switch panel for extensive tone shaping. [1] [2] The pedal retains the core controls of the original—Volume, Gain, Treble, and Bass—for shaping a balanced, musical tone without excessive coloration. The new Boost trim knob and dedicated footswitch allow on-the-fly addition of clean volume or gain, providing flexibility for solos or stacking. The external DIP switches offer four key options: a Compression switch (+6dB compression for tighter response), a Mode switch (Classic for the original AC Booster voicing, Modern for increased gain and articulation), a Lo Mid Boost (+6dB at 500Hz for enhanced lower mids), and a Hi Mid Boost (+6dB at 2kHz for added upper-mid presence). These features enable users to dial in more open, dynamic sounds by reducing compression or tailoring midrange emphasis. [1] [2] True bypass switching preserves signal integrity when disengaged, and the pedal runs on 9VDC (10mA max) and supports direct 9–18VDC operation for greater headroom , brightness, and less compression, with an optional Voltage Doubler available to achieve higher voltages from a 9V supply. Designed for players seeking responsive, open-sounding overdrive that reacts naturally to picking dynamics and guitar volume knob adjustments, the AC Booster V2 builds on the original's reputation while expanding tonal versatility. [1] [2] Overview Description The Xotic AC Booster V2 is an updated overdrive and boost pedal produced by Xotic Effects, released in 2025 as a modernized successor to the original AC Booster introduced more than two decades earlier. It retains the core characteristics of the classic design while incorporating enhanced features for greater tonal versatility and dynamic expression. [1] [3] The pedal delivers a wide range of overdrive tones characterized by touch-sensitive response and amp-like dynamics, capable of producing subtle clean boosts to more pronounced medium-gain overdrive. It emphasizes flexibility in achieving open-sounding tones through external DIP switches that allow users to tailor the sound with options for compression, classic or modern voicing modes, and mid-frequency boosts. These additions enable players to customize transparency and articulation to suit different playing styles and amplifier interactions. [1] [2] [3] A key enhancement is the inclusion of a footswitchable secondary boost stage with its own dedicated gain control, providing on-demand signal enhancement for solos or lead lines without altering the primary overdrive character. This combination of features makes the AC Booster V2 a highly adaptable tool for guitarists seeking responsive, open-sounding overdrive with expanded creative options compared to its predecessor. [1] [3] [2] Development The Xotic AC Booster was originally introduced in 2002 by Xotic Effects as a smooth overdrive pedal inspired by the Vox AC30 amplifier. [4] After more than two decades, during which the original became popular for its amp-like touch sensitivity and dynamic response among players including session guitarists, Xotic Effects released the AC Booster V2 in March 2025 as a next-generation update.
